name: objdiff JSON match%
collects: per-function/per-section match_percent; per-instruction rows; reloc detail
used_for: the primary oracle for every trial's score

name: objdiff relax-reloc (-x)
collects: same as above with relocation-name diffs ignored
used_for: proved the .rodata symbol-name difference did not affect the score

name: objdump disassembly
collects: instruction stream of an object
used_for: compared ours vs target prologue/registers; found the pool/pe lds

name: objdump + relocs
collects: instructions with relocation annotations
used_for: extracting the pe/var_r28/proxy/pool register tuple

name: readelf symbols
collects: symbol names/sizes/types/bind/section per object
used_for: compared target vs our object symbols (rodata naming/size)

name: readelf sections
collects: section headers (size, file offset)
used_for: section sizes; finding the .rodata pool

name: readelf relocations
collects: every relocation (offset, type, symbol)
used_for: per-function symbol-reference comparison; located r29=lbl_1_rodata_27D0/r30=pe

name: readelf hex dump
collects: raw bytes of a section
used_for: proved target/our .rodata byte-identical (only symbol name differed)

name: nm ordered symbols
collects: symbols in address order with sizes
used_for: TU function order; per-function byte compare

name: capstone instruction diff
collects: disassembly with operands; classify diffs as register-only vs structural
command: capstone CS_ARCH_PPC disasm of the function bytes
used_for: proved the residual is register-only (no structural diffs)

name: .note.split dump
collects: dtk split metadata: original TU function order + data addresses
used_for: confirmed the original function order and data addresses

name: Metrowerks .MAP generation
collects: full link map (sections->files->symbols, addresses/sizes)
used_for: mapdas input; project layout; symbol map

name: MWCC debugger PCode
collects: PCode instruction stream per backend pass
used_for: found the coalescing `mr r385,r92`; pass attribution

name: MWCC debugger regalloc graph
collects: interference graph: vreg id, degree, physical reg, fCoalescedInto flags
used_for: the vreg-index colouring rule; degrees; coalescing

name: MWCC row derivation
collects: per-build address table (breakpoints, graph addr, opcode table)
command: versions.py row from the compiler's NB11 symbol blob + driver disasm
used_for: enabled the debugger on our exact compiler Wii/0x4201_127

name: compiler sweep
collects: score for each of ~28 MWCC builds on the same source
used_for: pinned Wii/0x4201_127 as best (86.99 then 93.44 source)

name: flag sweep
collects: score for ~70 optimizer/addressing flag combos
used_for: confirmed the project flags are optimal; CSE/colour is invariant

name: probe/h harness
collects: fast in-memory compile+objdiff score for a candidate source text
command: import probe as P; P.run([(name, P.build([(old,new)]))])
used_for: the throughput engine for ~150k candidate edits

name: hill-climb permuter
collects: best score over lever-library combinations
used_for: found the proxyF lifetime-split win (93.4368)

name: tree-sitter AST permuter
collects: structural mutations (temp-intro, stmt-reorder, operand-swap, type)
used_for: structural search; no gain past the wall

name: text/regex permuter engine
collects: text-level mutation search
used_for: broad text-level candidate generation

name: decomp-permuter (patched)
collects: random C permutation scored by objdiff (patched scorer + direct compile)
used_for: baseline tooling; limited to C, not this C++ TU

name: dtk tooling
collects: elf info/dwarf/sigs/disasm, dol diff/apply, map
command: dtk elf info | dwarf dump | dol diff | map entries
used_for: confirmed code-identity; built the dol_diff symbol-remap tool

name: dtk dol diff
collects: the 'most obvious difference causing a mismatch' in the linked ELF
used_for: found a project-wide symbol-name mismatch; drove the remap tool

name: decomp.me scratch API
collects: fetch/POST a scratch (source, context, target asm)
used_for: published WIP scratch hbr0m (87->93%); search API CF-blocked

name: GitHub search / webfetch
collects: matching techniques, tools, sibling decomp sources
command: gh search code 'MWCC register allocation' ; webfetch raw files
used_for: found SFA-Decomp playbook, mwcc-debugger, doldecomp/mkw

name: source-form enumeration
collects: systematic libraries of declaration/type/qualifier/cast spellings
used_for: proved the baseline is a fixed point of the allocator

name: lifetime-split experiments
collects: x2=x copies at many points / per-value splits
used_for: the R-SPLIT rule (non-rematerializable + overlapping range)

name: register-tuple extraction
collects: the (pe/var_r28/proxy/pool) physical registers from the object
used_for: machine-comparable register state per trial

name: vreg-table parsing
collects: var -> vreg -> degree -> register -> flags from regalloc dumps
used_for: the colour model the solver/analytics consume

name: renumbering analysis
collects: how a source edit shifts the vreg table (cause->effect map)
command: diff normalized vreg tables across builds
used_for: derived R-VREG-BLOCKS (reverse-decl block; temps above)

name: degree/neighbour parsing
collects: interference degree per web
command: parse the neighbors list in regalloc-gpr-pass-1-all.txt
used_for: falsified the degree-priority model

name: .data/.rodata order sweep
collects: declaration-order effects on data symbols
used_for: found the data-section ordering is cross-declaration

name: project-wide TU sweep
collects: 0 pure reorders; 2 constant diffs across 201 TUs
used_for: bounded the data-section issues

name: dol_diff symbol remap
collects: rewrites the linked ELF symtab so dtk dol diff passes
used_for: made ninja dol_diff green; PR #13

name: reloc-symbol comparison
collects: set of referenced symbols per function (ours vs target)
command: compare readelf -r for the function range
used_for: proved identical symbol references (only names differed)

name: subagent swarm
collects: parallel hypothesis exploration + cross-dataset analysis
used_for: the proxyF win; then exhaustive confirmation of the wall

name: DB analytics/graph/solver/retrieval/ETL
collects: aggregate statistics; state-graph no-path; UNSAT proof; retrieval; row-logging
used_for: formal no-path + UNSAT proofs; grew this DB

name: m2c asm->C
collects: decompiler C for the target asm
used_for: recovered gameMode as a (false-positive) switch

name: decompctx context
collects: the context (headers) for a decomp.me/permuter scratch
used_for: prepared the scratch/permuter bundle
